notes: A monochrome generative-art gallery site: animated hero flow-field canvas, six seeded procedural artworks (ridgelines, harmonograph, moire, halftone bloom, ordered dither, paper weave) with re-run and expand controls, an interactive halftone lab with contrast/gamma/cell/angle/pattern controls and working PNG export, manifesto, colophon and footer. Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, zero dependencies, relative paths, works from file:// and GitHub Pages. Known limitations: system font stacks only (no webfont files, to stay dependency-free); artwork appearance varies by seed since every image is generated at run time; canvases require JavaScript.
